subject: general
question: Under which Article of the Indian constitution, there is provision for the election commission?
solution:
The correct answer is** 324.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **The Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering Union and State election processes in India.**
 
• **Article 324 gives the constitutional validity to this body.**
 
• The body administers elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies in India, and the offices of the President and Vice President in the country. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Election Commission of India is a permanent Constitutional Body.**
 
• The Election Commission was established in accordance with the Constitution on 25th January 1950.
 
• The Commission celebrated its Golden Jubilee in 2001.
 
• Originally the commission had only a Chief Election Commissioner.
 
• **It currently consists of Chief Election Commissioner and two Election Commissioners.**
 
• For the first time two additional Commissioners were appointed on 16th October 1989 but they had a very short tenure till 1st January 1990.
 
• Later, on 1st October 1993 two additional Election Commissioners were appointed.
 
• The concept of multi-member Commission has been in operation since then, with decision making power by majority vote.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The President appoints Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners.**
 
• They have **tenure of six years**, or up to** the age of 65 years,** whichever is earlier.
 
• They enjoy the same status and receive salary and perks as available to Judges of the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner can be **removed from office only through impeachment.**
